legend: Eddard and his secret partner believe arrays should be symmetric, and any asymmetric array is worthless. So, they defined a function V(a)$$$V(a)$$$ as the value of array a$$$a$$$ as follows:
If the array is symmetric*, V(a)$$$V(a)$$$ is equal to the sum of all elements in a$$$a$$$.
Given an array a$$$a$$$, calculate ∑nl=1∑nr=lV(a[l..r])$$$\sum_{l=1}^{n}\sum_{r=l}^{n}V(a[l..r])$$$, where a[l..r]$$$a[l..r]$$$ is the subarray of a$$$a$$$ from index l$$$l$$$ to r$$$r$$$.
Since the answer can be too large, print it modulo 109+7$$$10^9+7$$$.

* A symmetric array is an array that stays the same when reversed. More formally, in a symmetric array a$$$a$$$ of n$$$n$$$ integers, ai=an+1−i$$$a_i = a_{n+1-i}$$$ for 1≤i≤n$$$1 \le i \le n$$$. For example, the arrays [1,3,1],[5,9,9,5],[25]$$$[1, 3, 1], [5, 9, 9, 5], [25]$$$ are symmetric, while [1,2],[4,6,4,4]$$$[1, 2], [4, 6, 4, 4]$$$ are not.
input: Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤104)$$$(1 \le t \le 10^4)$$$. The description of the test cases follows.
The first line of each test case contains the array length n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤106)$$$(1 \le n \le 10^6)$$$.
The second line of each test case contains n$$$n$$$ integers a1,a2,...,an$$$a_1, a_2,...,a_n$$$ (1≤ai≤109)$$$(1 \le a_i \le 10^9)$$$.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n$$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 106$$$10^6$$$.
output: For each test case, print the answer modulo 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$.

legend.ai: Eddard 和他的秘密伙伴认为数组应当是对称的，任何非对称数组都毫无价值。因此，他们定义了函数 V(a)$$$V(a)$$$，表示数组 a$$$a$$$ 的价值，定义如下：
如果数组是对称的*，则 V(a)$$$V(a)$$$ 等于 a$$$a$$$ 中所有元素之和。
给定一个数组 a$$$a$$$，计算 ∑nl=1∑nr=lV(a[l..r])$$$\sum_{l=1}^{n}\sum_{r=l}^{n}V(a[l..r])$$$，其中 a[l..r]$$$a[l..r]$$$ 是数组 a$$$a$$$ 中从下标 l$$$l$$$ 到 r$$$r$$$ 的子数组。
由于答案可能很大，请输出答案对 109+7$$$10^9+7$$$ 取模的结果。

input.ai: 每个测试包含多个测试用例。第一行包含测试用例数量 t$$$t$$$(1≤t≤104)$$$(1 \le t \le 10^4)$$$。下面给出各测试用例的描述。
每个测试用例的第一行包含数组长度 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤106)$$$(1 \le n \le 10^6)$$$。
保证所有测试用例中 n$$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 106$$$10^6$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出答案对 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$ 取模的结果。
